_comment: Shrink-only quality floors for the crypto-crime mission eval. An actual below a floor is a HARD CI FAILURE (see gate.py). Raising a floor is an explicit reviewable edit; lowering one requires a written justification, exactly like the eval/baselines ratchet. These numbers were MEASURED live on 2026-09-28 against Qdrant dim 2560 with the direct-Qdrant retriever (no rerank). They are the honest starting point, not an aspiration.

_measured_2026_09_28.note: rug_history=0.00 gold and technical_analysis=0.00 gold are REAL capability gaps (no rug_events collection, no TA substrate), not flaky rows. The per_class floors below deliberately sit at 0.0 for those two so a further collapse to zero coverage is caught, while any IMPROVEMENT raises the floor.

_measured_2026_09_28_taeval.retriever: rugbrain.eval.harness.direct_qdrant_retriever against Qdrant http://127.0.0.1:6334, no rerank, no dual-tier
_measured_2026_09_28_taeval.embedding_lane: DeepInfra Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-4B, dim 2560, matching the master_skills collection dim
_measured_2026_09_28_taeval.method: All 8 technical_analysis cases graded gold at rank 1 by EXACT Qdrant point id (not by term match), so the score is not an artifact of loose substring matching.
_measured_2026_09_28_taeval.note: technical_analysis floor raised 0.0 -> 1.0 to the MEASURED value. This is a shrink-only ratchet: the class now scores 8/8 and any regression below 1.0 is a hard gate failure. The old ta-01 row scored a clean miss because it asked a liquidation-cascade question that no populated collection answers; it was repointed at master_skills (the populated TA reference corpus) rather than left to measure nothing.
